findings.claim: The SurrealDB password is passed as a process command-line argument, exposing the secret through container inspection/process metadata.
findings.evidence: The new `surreal` service command includes `--pass` followed by `${FRF_SURREAL_PASSWORD}` in `compose.yml`, while the constraints state under S1 that secrets must come from env/secret-manager handling and RUNBOOK marks `ENTITY_PROJECTION_PASSWORD` as a secret.
findings.suggested_fix: Use SurrealDB's supported environment/file-based secret mechanism or an entrypoint that reads the password from a mounted secret file without placing it in argv.

findings.claim: The integration SurrealDB fixture also passes its password on the command line, leaking per-run credentials into inspectable container metadata.
findings.evidence: The new integration compose command is `["start", "--log", "info", "--user", "${FRF_PROJECTION_SURREAL_USER:?required}", "--pass", "${FRF_PROJECTION_SURREAL_PASSWORD:?required}", "memory"]`, putting the secret in argv.
findings.suggested_fix: Read the fixture password from an env var or temporary secret file inside the container instead of passing it as a command argument.
